package.name: inf_client_wifi
package.description: Plain-DDS client running on the robot: republishes /scan and /odom onto off-board-visible topics with WiFi-appropriate QoS, so inf_server can subscribe to them directly with no custom transport in between. The DDS sibling of inf_client (gRPC/TCP) and inf_client_udp (raw datagrams) -- the control condition those two are measured against.
